name: telegram-red-envelope
description: Custodial Telegram Mini App crypto red envelope and wallet platform

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@red-envelope/shared && npm run build --workspace=@red-envelope/backend && npm run build --workspace=@red-envelope/frontend && npm run build --workspace=@red-envelope/admin
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend,admin -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=@red-envelope/backend" "npm run dev --workspace=@red-envelope/frontend" "npm run dev --workspace=@red-envelope/admin"
scripts.lint: npm run typecheck --workspace=@red-envelope/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@red-envelope/backend && npm run typecheck --workspace=@red-envelope/frontend && npm run typecheck --workspace=@red-envelope/admin
